CENSUS VERDICT on the ADDR16_LO-homed-via-r0 residual (parent: claim.law.addr16-lo-address-homed-via-r0-is-source-unreachable.20260831.v1). The full image-wide census settles the population, the direction, and the discriminant question; it does NOT yield a source lever, and it names precisely why.

POPULATIONS (2983 paired functions; classified per (function, symbol) by how a file-scope address reaches its callee-saved home):
  shape A = `lis rT,SYM@ha; addi rHOME,rT,SYM@lo` (coalesced, direct)
  shape B = `lis rT,SYM@ha; addi r0,rT,SYM@lo; mr rHOME,r0` (home copy paid)
  P target=A ours=B (the divergence) = 24
  Q target=B ours=B (agreed copy)    = 28
  R target=A ours=A (agreed direct)  = 659
  S target=B ours=A (inverse)        = 0

FINDING 1 - THE POPULATION IS 24, NOT 4. The parent law and its work_claim treat this as a 3-4 instance phenomenon in pmotion/psfx/sounds. It is 24 instances across 17 TUs. The full P roster (unit :: function :: symbol :: home): game/audio/audio::AudioStreamPlay::sAudioState::r30; game/audio/dcs::dcsReadVags::lbl_80116F58::r30; game/audio/dcs::dcsReadCalls::lbl_80116F58::r31; game/boss/bosscam::TriggerCameraActivate::lbl_8023E880::r31; game/enemy/critter::CritterInitGeo::gIdentityMatrix::r29; game/enemy/enemy::fn_80046680::gPlayers::r26; game/game/combat::InitCamera::gIdentityMatrix::r25; game/game/gamemain::fn_80051E1C::lbl_80250E00::r31; game/game/gamemain::fn_8005351C::gIdentityMatrix::r27; game/game/gamemain::do_stats_display::lbl_80112538::r26; game/game/pmotion::PlayerCollideFloor::lbl_80282850::r30; game/game/pmotion::fn_80088714::lbl_80282850::r31; game/mb/mb_model::MBOX_BGLoadModelDone/Start/LoadModelFixed::lbl_80115DA8; game/sfx/psfx::LoadPlyrData::lbl_802828B0::r27; game/shop/shop::shop_setup::lbl_80122ED0::r21; game/sound/sounds::MapMusicStart::sSpeechNameBuf::r30; game/sound/sounds::AudioSetupLevelStreams::sSpeechNameBuf::r31; game/sound/sounds_evt::AudioSetupBossStreams::sSpeechNameBuf::r30; game/ui/auxscreen::init_mapscreen::lbl_8023DFD0::r31; game/world/gauntworld::LoadWorldData::lbl_80257680::r27; game/world/world::LoadWorldDone::lbl_8028C9A8::r28; game/world/worldcol::WorldCollide::lbl_8023CA40::r30. Only 4 of the 24 sit in functions already >=98% fuzzy (LoadWorldDone 98.75, dcsReadCalls 98.66, dcsReadVags 98.60, LoadPlyrData 98.42), so closing the mechanism alone would NOT flip 24 functions - it is one instruction each in mostly-unfinished bodies.

FINDING 2 - THE ERROR IS STRICTLY ONE-DIRECTIONAL. S = 0 in 683 opportunities. We never coalesce where retail pays the copy; we only ever fail to coalesce where retail succeeds. Our failure rate is 24/683 = 3.5%. A strictly one-directional, low-rate divergence in one optimizer decision is the signature of allocator-internal state, not of a source spelling.

FINDING 3 - THE RECORDED 'PRE-PROLOGUE SHADOW' MECHANISM IS A SYMPTOM, NOT THE MECHANISM. attempt.mapmusicstart-addr16-lo-home-copy-park.20260831.v1 explains its instance as: MWCC schedules the addi into the prologue shadow, where the callee-saved home cannot be written because it is not yet saved, forcing r0 plus a copy. That is TRUE of MapMusicStart and of exactly 12 of the 24 P instances. The other 12 - including BOTH pmotion instances that founded the parent law, plus LoadPlyrData, do_stats_display, fn_80046680, dcsReadVags, LoadWorldDone, WorldCollide, AudioStreamPlay, InitCamera, fn_8005351C, AudioSetupBossStreams - have the addi AFTER the frame setup on BOTH sides and still pay the copy. Confirmed independently: the target places a callee-saved-homed ADDR16_LO addi in the prologue shadow 0 times in 683 (it structurally cannot), so shadow placement is DOWNSTREAM of the coalescing decision, not upstream of it. The allocator decides r0+mr first; the scheduler then hoists the now-volatile-destination addi because it can. Do not treat shadow placement as causal.

FINDING 4 - TWELVE CANDIDATE DISCRIMINANTS MEASURED AND FALSIFIED. (1) SYMBOL SECTION / SIZE / ALIGNMENT: dead. 15 of the 16 distinct symbols in P also appear in R, i.e. the SAME global takes the direct shape in one function and the copy shape in another (gIdentityMatrix P=3/R=7, gPlayers P=1/R=36, lbl_80282850 P=2/R=1, sSpeechNameBuf P=3/R=2, lbl_802828B0 P=1/R=2, lbl_80115DA8 P=3/R=2, ...). No symbol-level property can discriminate. (2) PROLOGUE-SHADOW SCHEDULING FLAGS: dead. Shadow-size histograms are near-identical (target 1201/453/259/218/26, ours 1259/455/275/230/27) and BOTH cap at exactly 4 hoisted instructions; only 34 of 2983 functions disagree at all. Our build does not schedule the frame shadow more aggressively in general. (3) COMPILER VERSION: dead. matchtool probe of game/sound/sounds.c returns MapMusicStart = L+1/D13 under all six demo-family presets across BOTH proven compilers (GC/1.2.5n and GC/1.2.5) and both inline variants (demo, demo_nox, demo_i1) - byte-identical outcome. (4) -inline / exceptions FLAGS: dead, same table. (5) SAVE STYLE: not a separator (P is 24/24 stmw, but R is 617/659 stmw). (6) LEAF-NESS: dead (P 24/24 non-leaf, R 658/659 non-leaf). (7) HOME REGISTER IDENTITY: dead (P and R have the same r30/r31-skewed distribution). (8) FORMATION POSITION / EARLINESS: an aggregate signal exists (mean formation index as a fraction of function length: P 0.076 vs R 0.192) but it is CONFOUNDED and dies under matched controls - in the golden within-TU within-symbol control (pmotion, lbl_80282850) the R case get_player_pos forms at 0.028, EARLIER than both P cases (PlayerCollideFloor 0.036, fn_80088714 0.101); world/lbl_8028C9A8 inverts the same way (R InitWorldInfo 0.006 vs P LoadWorldDone 0.082). (9) REGISTER PRESSURE AT THE FORMATION POINT: dead by the same matched controls (aggregate cs_before P 1.33 vs R 2.61, but the golden control inverts). (10) HOME-FORMATION MULTIPLICITY: dead - P 2.00, Q 2.07, R 1.96 mean formations per function; solo fraction P 0.458, Q 0.536, R 0.514. (11) FORMATION ADJACENCY: dead (P mean min-gap 23.15 vs R 21.64). (12) HOME-REGISTER WEB MULTIPLICITY: dead for P (single-def fraction P 0.750 vs R 0.736).

FINDING 5 - THE POSITIVE CONTROL THAT VALIDATES THE APPARATUS, AND A NEW LAW FOR Q. Axis (12) DOES separate Q sharply from both P and R: the home register carries a mean of 3.00 definitions in Q versus 1.54 in P and 1.68 in R, and only 4/28 Q homes are single-def versus 485/659 in R. This is the classic copy-coalescing interference condition - when the callee-saved home is reused for several distinct values across the function, the address temp and the home genuinely interfere and NO allocator can coalesce them, which is exactly why retail pays the copy in Q too. NEW LAW: an ADDR16_LO home copy is EXPECTED and correct wherever the home register carries multiple webs; do not spend probes on a Q-class copy. The methodological value is that this is a POSITIVE CONTROL: the same census machinery that finds a 0.143-vs-0.736 separation for Q finds a 0.750-vs-0.736 non-separation for P, so the apparatus is demonstrably sensitive enough to detect a real discriminant in this variable space, and P's null result is a genuine null rather than a measurement failure.

VERDICT AND DISPOSITION. Within-TU, within-symbol, same-cflags, same-compiler, same-source-spelling controls exist for the majority of P (pmotion/lbl_80282850, psfx/lbl_802828B0, sounds/sSpeechNameBuf, mb_model/lbl_80115DA8, world/lbl_8028C9A8, worldcol/lbl_8023CA40, gamemain/lbl_80112538), and in every one of them the discriminating variable is invisible to all twelve measured axes. The purest instance is pmotion::fn_80088714, whose stream is byte-identical to target through offset 0x34 and then diverges solely at the addi's destination register with r31 provably free. The residual is therefore CONFIRMED source-unreachable, and now with the discriminating variable NAMED AS ABSENT: it is not any function-visible property of the symbol, the schedule, the frame, the pressure, the webs, the flags, or the compiler build - it is MWCC's internal coalescing worklist order, which is not a function of anything observable in the emitted stream. STOP SPENDING SOURCE PROBES ON P-CLASS INSTANCES. Every P instance is count-asymmetric (ours exactly one instruction long), so per claim.law.webfrank-cannot-close-a-count-asymmetric-residual.20260831.v1 the whole class is ALSO WebFrank-ineligible on both the recolor-size and permutation-bijection preconditions - the parent law's disposition recommending a WebFrank REGISTER_ONLY rule is unsafe for all 24 and should not be acted on. The correct handling is to treat a P-class `mr` as a known, named, accepted one-instruction residual and to finish the surrounding body on its own merits.

FINDING 6 - THE MECHANISM IS SPECIFIC TO ADDR16_LO AND DOES NOT GENERALISE TO PLAIN REGISTER COPIES (tested at the integrator's request). Censused every `mr rCS,r0` / `addi rCS,r0,0` homing on both sides image-wide and classified what DEFINED r0. In the 31 functions where ours pays MORE r0->callee-saved homings than target, the r0 producer is an ADDR16_LO `addi` in 26; the remaining 5 are backward-walk artifacts on non-writing opcodes (stw/cmpwi/cmplwi/rlwimi/lhax), so the surplus class is effectively 100% ADDR16_LO address materialisation. Decisively, the five parks the control-flow lane flagged as sharing a 'related extra-address-copy signature' - world/items::LoadItems, world/world::StartWorldLoad, ui/select::init_player_change, pb/pb_objregs::pbDrawVerts, enemy/critter::ProcessCritterList - carry ZERO r0->callee-saved homings on EITHER side (T=0, O=0 for all five). Their surplus `addi rX,rY,0` copies are a DIFFERENT mechanism and must be diagnosed on their own; this law does not cover them and the P-class do-not-probe disposition does not extend to them. Note also that the census independently rediscovered LoadWorldDone and LoadWorldData - the instances that lane found by hand - which is a useful completeness check on the roster.
